atAGlance: Bì cuốn is fresh rolls with shredded pork skin, usually with rice paper, herbs, noodles, thính, and nước chấm, a lime-fish-sauce dip with sugar, garlic, and chili.
whatItIs: Bì cuốn are rice-paper rolls filled with shredded pork skin, toasted rice powder, herbs, noodles, and often nước chấm. The toasted rice powder gives the pork its nutty aroma.
howToEnjoy: Dip lightly so the rice paper stays intact and the toasted-rice aroma of the bì remains clear. Eat soon, while the herbs are fresh.
howLocalsOrder: Order bì cuốn by the plate or roll. Ask for nước chấm on the side, no pork, or extra herbs before the rolls are served.
worthKnowing: Bì means shredded pork skin mixed with thính, toasted rice powder; it is much more aromatic than the English phrase suggests.
